title: Elux Legend Fresh Mint Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Elux Legend's Fresh Mint Nic Salt delivers a crisp and invigorating vape with its pure and refreshing Mint flavour. With every puff, you’ll enjoy the clean, cooling sensation of fresh Mint, making it an ideal choice for vapers seeking a smooth and simple flavour profile with a frosty edge. Elux Legend Nic Salts are double-concentrated to replicate the bold, intense flavours of Elux’s bestselling disposable vapes. Crafted with a smooth nicotine salt formula, these e-liquids provide near-instant nicotine relief with minimal throat irritation, ensuring a satisfying and flavoursome vape experience. Blended with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Fresh Mint Nic Salt is designed for use with Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) devices and refillable pod kits. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, this e-liquid offers a versatile option for adult smokers and vapers.
